discussion_comments.comment_body:
All thing into the `message` will be translated into a item of list in markdown during the release, so let's make it better.

For example

```markdown
message: |
  Improved the output of the request debugger
  - Now the resolution of field `total_time` is microseconds when it is less than 1ms instead of confusing 0ms.
  - A new field `total_time_without_upstream` on the top level shows the latency only introduced by Kong
```
